categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: aerospace precision parts and tooling, and multi-industry precision parts for civilian use. It focuses on manufacturing and process development of aerospace components including airframe parts, engine parts, and onboard equipment, while also expanding into sectors such as shipbuilding, electronics, and semiconductors. Additionally, it has developed a computing power service and sales business related to artificial intelligence.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 12 core proprietary technologies including CNC deformation control for thin-walled metal structures, high-efficiency multi-axis machining of aerospace high-temperature alloys, composite processing of ultra-high strength steel structures, and intelligent CNC programming with online detection. It employs advanced manufacturing processes such as multi-axis machining, composite machining, precision welding, and flexible tooling systems based on zero-point positioning. The company also integrates digital management systems like MES and focuses on intelligent manufacturing and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major state-owned military-industrial groups such as Aviation Industry Corporation of China, China Aviation Engine Group, China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, China Shipbuilding Group, and China Electronics Technology Group. The company serves primarily the aerospace sector with military and civil aircraft manufacturers, and also supplies to shipbuilding, electronics, and semiconductor industries. Its computing power services cater to research institutions and enterprises in artificial intelligence and big data.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and major facilities located in Suzhou and Zhengzhou. Its customer base is predominantly domestic, including large Chinese military-industrial enterprises and civilian aerospace manufacturers. There is no significant mention of overseas operations or markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer and processor in the aerospace supply chain, providing precision parts and tooling directly to aircraft OEMs and military clients. It also extends its manufacturing capabilities to civilian industries and offers computing power services, positioning itself as both a component supplier and a technology service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening aerospace core technology innovation, expanding into new business areas such as AI computing power services, and enhancing digital and intelligent manufacturing capabilities. The company emphasizes R&D in advanced machining technologies, materials processing, and tooling design, supported by collaborations with universities and research institutes. Talent development and internal management optimization are also key focus areas to sustain innovation and operational excellence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of aerospace precision parts and tooling products, as well as multi-industry precision components. The company also earns income from providing computing power services and sales related to artificial intelligence infrastructure. Pricing is based on product complexity, labor hours, material costs, and negotiated contracts, primarily through direct sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading private aerospace parts manufacturer in China with comprehensive capabilities across airframe, engine, and onboard equipment components. It holds a competitive edge through proprietary technologies and strong relationships with major state-owned aerospace groups. While the report does not list specific competitors, it highlights the company's recognized status as an excellent supplier and its strategic role in the evolving aerospace supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 476.8 million, a 62.35% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 45.5 million, up 198.73%. The company has shown strong growth driven by increased aerospace orders and new computing power business. Total assets grew significantly to RMB 2.17 billion with an increased leverage ratio. R&D investment reached over RMB 30 million, supporting sustained innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced precision manufacturing technologies, high-quality standards, and integrated product and service offerings tailored to aerospace and other high-tech industries. Its unique value lies in proprietary core technologies, comprehensive capabilities across multiple aerospace component categories, and the ability to rapidly respond to customized military and civilian requirements. The integration of digital and intelligent manufacturing systems further differentiates its products and services, ensuring high reliability and performance.
